stem.en: What does the Junagadh Rock Inscription near Girnar preserve?

text.en: Records of the Maurya, Western Satrap and Gupta dynasties, spanning about 700 years.
Records of one dynasty, cut by a line of kings from father to son.
A list of all sixteen mahājanapadas.
A law code that all later rulers had to follow.

explanation.en: The rock preserves inscriptions of Aśhoka, Rudradaman I and Skandagupta. They span about 700 years and give valuable information about administration, public works and political history.

hints.en: How many rulers inscribed this rock?
The earliest inscription is from the 3rd century BCE and the latest from the 5th century CE.
